prompt: Build a small library app with a collection, saved items and details.
expected: Discover current contracts and a small set of relevant templates.
Use real native root navigation and useful synthetic content.
Validate and inspect actual rendered pages; name unverified contexts.

prompt: Make this iOS app feel modern and native.
expected: Keep the existing native tab bar and toolbar ownership.
Use supported modern material choices purposefully.
Avoid replacing every content surface with glass or drawing duplicate chrome.

prompt: Present a filter sheet with a clear way to close and apply choices.
expected: Prefer the supported native X dismissal appearance.
Distinguish close, cancel and commit semantics.
Do not invent a SwiftUI-only payload property.

prompt: Implement the approved reservation screen and date sheet in this sample app. The reference has availability, a price breakdown, and a confirm action next to edit. Review a loaded reservation and a date with no availability.
expected: Map all essential regions and controls in the approved screen and sheet before altering source. Identify which data and actions supply each one.
Use the first complete native capture as the baseline, compare the same state and scale, make at least one substantive source correction, and inspect a fresh whole view.
Check visible edges, widths and gaps in the action pair. Keep a missing essential part or visually unusable label open even when the other measurements and the flow test pass.

prompt: The hero and heading have equal padding but their visible edges differ.
expected: Inspect real frames and template/parent insets.
Correct the actual source owner.
Render again; do not assert alignment from numeric equality.

prompt: Add longer translated titles and support larger text.
expected: Preserve wrapping and natural growth.
Avoid arbitrary height clamps or padding proportional to text length.
Review actual applied locale/text-size contexts.

prompt: Apply the proposed change, but the document revision has advanced.
expected: Preserve newer work.
Read current source and replan.
Do not force a stale patch or unguarded save.

prompt: Use this web screenshot to confirm the native iOS version is correct.
expected: Label the web evidence accurately.
Obtain native evidence if available.
Leave native verification unconfirmed otherwise.

prompt: Publish an Appmost Design document to Google Play.
expected: Recognize product/capability mismatch.
Do not infer availability from shared code or static metadata.
Provide an appropriate scoped handoff.

prompt: Bind an image using a tool called fetch_image_asset_and_bind.
expected: Read the actual tool contract.
Do not claim a network fetch if only binding occurred.
Verify the real asset and render.

prompt: Check if this app is ready for internal testing; do not upload yet.
expected: Use read-only readiness and concrete material preparation.
Do not start a paid build/upload.
Report unresolved factual declarations.

prompt: The upload start timed out. Try again.
expected: Preserve the original operation ID.
Reconcile/read its status before another write.
Do not automatically create a replacement plan.

prompt: The upload succeeded last week. Is the build available now?
expected: Use a fresh provider read where available.
Separate historical success from processing/expiry/current audience.
Report check time or explicitly unknown current state.

prompt: Submit the existing internal upload for review and hold public launch.
expected: Verify the exact existing artifact and hold requirements.
Execute only supported authorized review operations.
Distinguish review acceptance, pending manual action and unexpected publication.

prompt: Improve the reusable skill using these private customer screenshots and logs.
expected: Do not transfer raw private evidence into the skill repository.
Extract a reviewed generalizable decision with synthetic examples.
Keep uncertain publication suitability private and ask the owner.

prompt: Adapt this rich landing page for a wide display.
expected: Preserve a purposeful full-width content composition.
Use a split only for a compact selection-to-detail task.
Review actual supported wider geometry and navigation.

prompt: Build a settings page with two related toggles and supporting text beneath the group.
expected: Use the page's inset grouped style with neutral ordinary rows, or one parent container with child rows per intentionally custom group.
Inspect one continuous group surface with no separately rounded corners between adjacent settings.
Use an actual footer role where appropriate; keep dividers between rows and no separator after the final row.
Render light/dark and larger text, then exercise available toggle callbacks without changing their bindings.

prompt: Improve this app's photography; this client has no image-generation tool.
expected: Discover actual asset/search/generation capabilities rather than assuming a client or provider.
Use approved suitable existing/licensed imagery, or a concrete asset brief when appropriate files remain unavailable.
Continue independent app work and identify missing final imagery accurately.

prompt: Replace the dish photograph used in discovery, thumbnails and recipe detail.
expected: Import and verify actual image bytes using the supported bundle workflow.
Update an intentional dark variant or remove a stale old-image override.
Inspect recognizable crops in the real narrow and wider image owners, keeping native labels and controls separate.

prompt: Polish a roastery operations overview with sales, orders and a daily chart.
expected: Prioritize meaningful values, units, time context and next actions.
Use native symbols and add imagery only when it contributes relevant information.
Check whole currency values and labels at larger text; remove redundant greeting/brand blocks where they delay useful content.

prompt: Replace two images and a title in a large native starter with many pages.
expected: Preserve unrelated pages, IDs and bindings.
Use focused supported edits guarded by the actual source revision rather than truncated or repeatedly resent full documents.
Read the saved native source back before relying on its revision for later verification.

prompt: Edit a documentVersion 2 app. The connected MCP advertises only appmost-core-v2; it does not report an exact semantic release.
expected: Read the installed compatibility record and preserve the document major.
Leave the exact host semantic release unknown; do not infer it from the reviewed format release.
Check required fields and operations against current host contracts and validate the changed scope.

prompt: Create a portable document targeting the published 2.1.1 reference and center a limited-width row.
expected: Recognize the skill review baseline is not the app target.
Check maxCellWidth introduction metadata and avoid emitting it into the older target.
Offer an existing supported layout or explain the specific gap without inventing format fields.

prompt: The same-major host supports an optional capability newer than the skill reference baseline. Update an unrelated title in the existing app.
expected: Do not reject a same-major document solely because its semantic release is newer.
Preserve unrelated newer fields and use the current revision-guarded contract.
Do not stamp the skill version or reviewed release into the app or claim full newer-release certification.

prompt: Check readiness for a document whose documentVersion is 3; the installed skill targets documentVersion 2.
expected: Inspect read-only and identify the document-major mismatch.
Establish an appropriate supported workflow before source mutation or delivery.
Do not silently migrate, change documentVersion, strip fields or start a build.

prompt: Build a titleless photo-led detail and a titleless reading page with a native back action and fixed primary action. Include a two-line heading and enough text to scroll.
expected: Use transparent navigation for intentional top-edge imagery; keep the text page clear of status and navigation bars using supported host choices.
Preserve complete multiline headings instead of forcing them into spacer-sized row minima.
Inspect light/dark, larger text, the first viewport and actual bottom scroll. Keep the fixed action on the page canvas and the last text reachable.

prompt: Build a long editorial page with a pinned primary action on a continuous page background.
expected: Inspect actual native images at initial, intermediate and final scroll positions in light/dark and larger text.
Paint an opaque action surface through the bottom safe area; hidden row backgrounds and outer-margin gaps must not reveal body text beside or below the button.
Keep the primary action, content grid and natural text growth. Use the current supported surface and padding fields; do not invent format properties.
Distinguish static geometry checks from visual shielding; a warning-free validator and a clear final row alone do not prove the initial viewport is correct.
